instruction: When forwarding emails, I prefer to have the original message included inline in the body rather than as an attachment. Could you configure Thunderbird to forward messages inline?

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring forward mode by setting mail.forward_message_mode to 0 (inline). This preference controls how messages are forwarded: 0=inline, 1=as attachment, 2=ask each time.
metadata.verification: The preference mail.forward_message_mode is a standard Thunderbird setting: 0 forwards inline (in message body), 1 forwards as attachment, 2 asks user each time.
